defaults.rule: Always ask which cluster (dev / staging / prod, or any kube context) first. If none is named, default to dev — never the current kube context. Refuse an unknown context (the cluster guard).
Show every command before running it. The scripts echo each kubectl/talosctl call; surface them.
Read-only everywhere except the remediate route, which opens a git PR and never touches the cluster.
This skill targets clusters, not a repository — there is no repo guard; the guard is the cluster context. It runs against the lab or any org's clusters.

route.when: health, is the cluster healthy, nodes ready, etcd, control plane, control-plane down, apiserver, is ops healthy, check the cluster, what's wrong with dev, cluster status
route.goal: Read-only health sweep: nodes Ready, etcd quorum, control-plane pods, Talos services.

route.when: reliability, probes, liveness, readiness, replicas, single replica, HA, PodDisruptionBudget, PDB, resource limits, will this survive a drain, SLO risk
route.goal: Find reliability gaps in user workloads: missing probes, single-replica/no-PDB, no limits.

route.when: security, security review, drift, privileged, runAsRoot, run as root, hostPath, hostNetwork, NetworkPolicy, netpol, pod security, is this hardened
route.goal: Scan for security drift: privileged containers, root, host namespaces/paths, missing NetworkPolicies.

route.when: cert, certificate, expiry, expiring, pki, rotate, when will the api break, outage prediction, talos cert, kubeconfig cert
route.goal: Compute cert days-to-expiry and predict the API outage window.

route.when: vulnerability, vuln, cve, cves, image scan, scan images, known vulnerable, patch status, are we behind on talos, talos version, kubernetes version, version currency, supply chain, latest tag, trivy, grype, patch management
route.goal: Read-only vulnerability review: Talos/Kubernetes version currency, image supply-chain hygiene (mutable :latest, untrusted registries), and (if trivy/grype present) image CVE scan.

route.when: upgrade, can we upgrade, upgrade readiness, version skew, deprecated api, removed api, preflight, talos upgrade, kubernetes upgrade, dry-run, rollback, fearless upgrade
route.goal: Read-only upgrade readiness: current versions, node version skew, deprecated/removed-API preflight (pluto/kubent if present), and the privileged A/B upgrade plan (never executed).

route.when: do we need kubernetes, is this k8s worthy, should this be on kubernetes, overkill, fargate, cloud run, too small for k8s, k8s overhead, right-size the platform
route.goal: Advisory: count service/workload/autoscaling/scale signals and judge whether the cluster justifies Kubernetes overhead vs ECS Fargate / Cloud Run.

route.when: report, maturity report, scorecard, score the platform, grade, how mature is this cluster, executive summary, overall health score
route.goal: Run all read-only capabilities and print a scored platform maturity report.

route.when: remediate, fix it, open a PR, raise a PR, auto-fix, apply the fix, add a PDB, generate the fix, gitops fix, make it self-heal
route.goal: Generate a fix manifest and open a PR to the Gitea platform repo; ArgoCD syncs on merge. Dry-run unless --apply.
